text: Tom Vane, a boatbuilder of fifty years, has died; he restored this boat for years and never launched her.
The estuary is tidal; the boat can be floated at the slip only for the short window around the top of the tide, near seven this morning.
Aldous has told Tom's old friends the launching is this morning; they are coming to the slip at the top of the tide.
Tom painted the hull the spring before he fell ill; the fresh paint hides the state of the wood beneath.
